findings.summary: Author-page normalization is duplicated in the request-state projection.
findings.consequence: The extra branch does not change behavior for direct callers, because route parsing already clamps author mode to page 1. Keeping the same invariant in two places makes future paging policy changes easier to update in only one layer and miss in the other.
findings.evidence: parseLibraryRouteState computes page through libraryPage, whose authors branch returns 1 before libraryRequestState is called by bibliotek.vue and the listed unit test. The owned line repeats that same authors-page rule instead of projecting the normalized route state.
findings.recommendation: Let this projection stay a pure shape boundary by using `page: state.page`, and keep mode-specific page canonicalization in the route parser.
